name: net_quote_demand_rank
rationale: Biais et al. (1995) show order book imbalance predicts price changes.

name: volume_price_correlation_proxy
rationale: Karpoff (1987) finds positive volume-price change correlation; we approximate with product.

name: volatility_breakout_strength
rationale: Timmermann (2009) volatility breakout: deviation of current volatility from historical range.

name: volume_weighted_reversal
rationale: Reversal strength weighted by volume (Lehmann 1990).

name: price_trend_slope_vol_adjusted
rationale: Trend following with volatility adjustment (Szakmary, Shen & Sharma 2010). This factor computes the slope of mid-price divided by volatility.

name: volume_conditional_spread
rationale: Huang Stoll (1997) volume conditional spread: spread normalized by volume.

name: energy_weighted_spread
rationale: Corwin-Schultz (2012) spread proxy: spread variability weighted by bid-ask energy captures hidden illiquidity.

name: spread_momentum
rationale: Trend in quoted spread signals building transaction cost pressure, similar to Hasbrouck (1991) information flow.

name: midprice_hurst_exponent_proxy
rationale: Proxy for Hurst via ratio of overlapping return std devs (Di Matteo et al. 2005).

name: ask_bid_price_ratio_log_diff
rationale: Log return of BestAsk/BestBid ratio measures relative spread change, signals tightening (Fleming 2001).

name: extreme_return_sum
rationale: Cumulative return during extreme events; directional extreme exposure.

name: volume_kurtosis_trade_size
rationale: Trade size kurtosis (Farmer et al. 2004).

name: depth_risk_adjusted_return
rationale: Sharpe 1966: risk-adjusted depth return

name: adverse_selection_impact_ratio
rationale: Average permanent price impact per trade relative to quoted spread, capturing adverse selection cost (Glosten and Milgrom 1985).

name: attn_market_impact_curve_proxy
rationale: Square root of volume times return sign approximates impact (Almgren et al. 2005)

name: volume_log_vol
rationale: Volatility of log volume: proportional changes smooth extreme values (Lobato & Velasco 2000).

name: depth_persistence_ratio
rationale: Mandelbrot fractal markets: ratio of depth volatility at long to short window indicates persistence.

name: flash_heating_proxy
rationale: Flash heating reduces friction (Rice 2006); here sudden spike in trade intensity (volume over very short window) compared to recent average, indicating potential large move (Easley et al. 2012).

name: hawk_dove_intensity_ratio
rationale: Hawk-Dove game (Maynard Smith & Price 1973): high aggressiveness (large trades) vs passivity; the ratio of 90th percentile to median trade size separates hawks from doves.

name: t_statistic_momentum
rationale: Lo & MacKinlay 1988: t-statistic of linear trend more robust than raw slope

name: depth_price_trend_interaction
rationale: Interaction of price trend and depth (Lo & MacKinlay 1988): depth changes during trends.

name: return_magnitude_dispersion
rationale: Cont (2001) volatility clustering implies magnitude dispersion varies. Coefficient of variation of |r| over 100 ticks.

name: spread_depth_momentum
rationale: Momentum in the spread-depth ratio (Chordia et al. 2000).

name: informed_flow_reversal
rationale: Price reversal after toxic trades indicates temporary impact (Hendershott et al. 2011).

name: noise_sweep_detection
rationale: Sweep detection noise: volume burst relative to depth as noise intensity (HFT sweeps).

name: mp_spread_dev_interaction
rationale: Product of spread and deviation (Kyle 1985).

name: midprice_reversal_after_large_trade
rationale: Madhavan-Smidt 1991: large trades cause temporary price pressure that reverts.

name: ask_side_pressure
rationale: Asymmetric focus on ask side: when ask size is large relative to bid, selling pressure dominates (Bollerslev and Melvin 1994).

name: relative_spread_depth
rationale: Spread relative to depth (liquidity premium) as adverse selection measure (Foucault 1999).

name: trade_impact_concavity
rationale: Lillo, Farmer, Mantegna (2003) concave impact: |return| / log(trade size).

name: volatility_memory_parkinson_to_close_ratio
rationale: Parkinson (1980) vs close vol; when ratio of range vol to close vol persists, trend emerges.

name: residual_inventory_effect
rationale: Lyons 1995: residual inventory effect: (imbalance - long-term mean) * return.

name: ask_bid_ratio_change
rationale: Cartea-Jaimungal-Penalva 2015: change in ratio of ask to bid size predicts order flow direction.

name: anchor_pain_ratio
rationale: Pain ratio (Zakamouline 2011) concept: sum of drawdowns divided by number of observations near the anchor; higher pain suggests higher likelihood of bounce.

name: trade_price_range_reversal
rationale: When trade prices trade in a narrow range, a breakout is false and reverses (Duclos 1985).

name: dd_zero_tick
rationale: Frequency of zero price changes increases during drawdowns signaling frozen markets (Madhavan-Richardson-Roomans 1997).

name: zcr_trade_price_30
rationale: ZCR of trade price returns captures transaction-level oscillation, reflecting speculative intensity (Mantegna and Stanley 1996).

name: rqa_determinism_mid_rolling_corr
rationale: Zbilut & Webber 1992 determinism on correlation; if correlation of mid with bid trends upward, bullish; trending down, bearish divergence.

name: cs_trade_arrival_clustering
rationale: Clustering of trades (variance of inter-trade intervals proxied by volume volatility) increases before crash (Engle 2000).

name: iceberg_ask_short_long_vol
rationale: Ask depth short-term vs long-term volatility; decreasing ratio implies growing hidden sell orders.

name: bid_ask_bounce_spillover
rationale: Roll 1984 bid-ask bounce transmits to short-term momentum

name: zscore_ljung_box_autocorr
rationale: Ljung-Box style test statistic: sum of squared autocorrelations of returns normalized, then z-score; detects predictability; Lo-MacKinlay (1988).

name: quantile_range_slope
rationale: Slope of the inter-quantile range (Max-Min) as a volatility-of-volatility measure (Christoffersen 2012).

name: volume_power_law_exponent
rationale: Gabaix-Gopikrishnan-Plerou-Stanley 2006: power-law exponent of volume via log-difference of max and sum

name: spread_sq_over_depth_volatility
rationale: A nonlinear adverse selection measure: spread squared times volatility divided by depth, amplifying regimes where all three spike.

name: vol_vol_volume_shock_10_50
rationale: Product of changes in vol-of-vol and volume; synchronized positive spikes indicate news-driven volatility.

name: bid_ask_spread_ratio_en
rationale: Hendershott & Menkveld (2014) intermediary constraints; entropy of the ratio of bid to ask depth provides inventory pressure signal.

name: asym_bidsize_slope_50
rationale: Slope asymmetry of bid depth conditional on price direction (Zumbach 2009)

name: omori_decay_2std
rationale: Omori 1894 aftershock decay: after a return >2 std, ratio of short to long volatility measures decay rate.

name: norm_dist_to_round
rationale: Osler (2003) distance normalized by spread reflects how close price is in tick units, amplifying signal near the round level.

name: depth_ratio_momentum_reversal
rationale: Chordia and Subrahmanyam (2004): depth ratio momentum exhausts and reverses.

name: seasonal_price_divergence
rationale: VWAP deviation; prices tend to revert to VWAP after intraday extremes caused by open/close flows.

name: kf_innovation_vol_bid_ask_asymmetry
rationale: Asymmetry in bid-ask innovation volatility signals market stress (Bollerslev and Todorov 2011).

name: csd_ret_var
rationale: Rising return variance is a classic early warning signal of critical transitions (Scheffer et al. 2009).

name: gjr_garch_leverage
rationale: Indicator of negative returns interacting with volatility (Glosten-Jagannathan-Runkle 1993 GJR-GARCH)
